title: Watch: Downed trees and flooding as Hurricane Lowell batters western Hawaii
summary: The storm brought damaging winds and torrential rain to parts of the island on Monday and Tuesday, triggering concerns about flash flooding and mudslides.

The centre of the storm passed west of the islands early Tuesday.
